# SheetJS vendored package

`xlsx-0.20.2.tgz` is an npm pack of the existing SheetJS 0.20.2 package used by this repository, originally distributed at https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.2/xlsx-0.20.2.tgz . It includes the Apache-2.0 LICENSE and original package contents. Keeping it here removes the build-time dependency on an external CDN; `package-lock.json` verifies integrity. Do not replace it with the older npm-registry version silently.
